tips.text: Do the three daily Perrin alerts and grab every medallion; they and the alert reward bypass the daily cap.
Level New Loka alongside Perrin; Red Veil is neutral, so skip Arbiters of Hexis and Steel Meridian.
Play normally with the Perrin pledge on until you hit the daily cap, then do the alerts.
Bring Loot Detector or Animal Instinct to spot invisible Perrin Quittances; the rare one has a cyan light column.
Use an Affinity booster on days you would cap anyway; standing comes from Affinity, so it counts double.
Remember Universal Syndicate Medallions count against the daily cap, unlike the Perrin ones.
Nobody struggles to get it; most owners bought it for Mastery or the rank-5 rewards, not to use it.
